detail:
- **Documented**: 11 of 17 modules carry an author's summary

31 requirements: 9 checked and 22 refuted.
label: scripts
quotes: build-mcp-firebase
Build script that compiles and packages the MCP server for deployment as a Firebase function.
build-mcp-metadata
Build-mcp-metadata generates the metadata used by the MCP server to describe and expose the design system's components and templates to an AI agent.
build-pieces
Documented the Build-pieces module as the script that assembles island components into buildable artifacts, writing the CSS manifest and enforcing tag-contract checks during the build.
check-islands
A build script that checks assembled island pieces by invoking the pieces-harness at runtime, with most of its underlying requirements currently unmet.
check-pieces
Check-pieces is a script that renders assembled pieces and validates their DOM output against the project's tag contract rules.
pieces-harness
Test harness utility that opens rendered pieces and creates a wrapper exposing helpers to query, mark, fill, and inspect slots and islands for validation scripts.
preact-alias
A Preact alias module providing an alternate entry point that maps the design system's React-based API onto the Preact runtime for lighter-weight rendering.
tag-contract
Tag-contract defines the rules a built piece's DOM output must satisfy, exposing a reader used by piece-validation checks to classify and verify tags.
cli

The Cli module is a command-line entry point for the design system renderer, parsing invocation flags to render talk pages or print contract, tag, and version information, and printing usage and exiting when invoked without valid arguments.
index
Index module acts as the server-side rendering entry point that parses talk content and assembles it into page output, coordinating component resolution, island hydration, and node encoding.
parse
Defines the parse module that converts raw markup into a structured tree used by rendering and node-resolution, with a tidy pass over the parsed output.
